articles.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-5 with Extended Reasoning and Native Multimodal Generation
articles.summary: OpenAI officially released GPT-5, featuring substantially improved long-horizon reasoning, native image and audio generation within a single model, and a 1M-token context window. Benchmarks show significant gains on ARC-AGI-2 and GPQA, and the model demonstrates notably fewer hallucinations on factual retrieval tasks compared to GPT-4o.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini 2.5 Ultra Achieves State-of-the-Art on Complex Coding Benchmarks
articles.summary: Google DeepMind released Gemini 2.5 Ultra, which tops SWE-Bench Verified and LiveCodeBench leaderboards, outperforming previous frontier models on real-world multi-file software engineering tasks. The model integrates a refined mixture-of-experts architecture and a novel self-verification step during inference that reduces logical errors in generated code.

articles.title: Figure Robotics Begins Commercial Deployment of Figure 03 Humanoids in BMW Factories
articles.summary: Figure announced that its third-generation humanoid robot, Figure 03, has entered full commercial deployment on BMW assembly lines in Spartanburg, South Carolina. The robots handle bin-picking, part insertion, and quality inspection tasks, operating alongside human workers with sub-millimeter dexterous manipulation and real-time LLM-driven task planning.

articles.title: Tesla Optimus Gen 3 Demonstrates Autonomous Household Tasks in Live Demo
articles.summary: Tesla showcased Optimus Gen 3 performing unscripted household chores including folding laundry, loading a dishwasher, and navigating cluttered environments without pre-mapped paths. The demo highlighted a new vision-language-action model trained on millions of hours of teleoperation data, marking a step toward Tesla's goal of consumer-grade humanoid assistants by 2028.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces Claude's 'Artifact Memory' for Persistent Multi-Session Project Collaboration
articles.summary: Anthropic rolled out a persistent memory and project workspace feature for Claude, enabling the assistant to maintain structured context across sessions for long-running engineering and research projects. The system uses a retrieval-augmented architecture with user-controlled memory banks, addressing a key limitation of stateless LLM interactions for professional workflows.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Volume Production of 1.4nm A14 Process Node
articles.summary: TSMC confirmed that its Fab 21 facility in Arizona has started volume production on the A14 (1.4nm-class) process using gate-all-around nanosheet transistors. The node delivers roughly 20% speed improvement and 30% power reduction over N2, and will first appear in next-generation AI accelerator chips from major hyperscalers later this year.

articles.title: Neuralink Receives FDA Approval for Second-Generation Brain-Computer Interface Implant
articles.summary: The FDA granted Neuralink approval to proceed with broader clinical trials for its N2 implant, which features 4,096 electrodes (4x the original) and wireless charging. Early trial participants with spinal cord injuries demonstrated cursor control speeds approaching able-bodied benchmarks, and the first trials for speech restoration in ALS patients are slated to begin in Q4 2026.

articles.title: Meta Open-Sources Llama 4 Behemoth with 2 Trillion Parameters Under Permissive License
articles.summary: Meta released the full weights of Llama 4 Behemoth, its largest open-weight model at over 2 trillion parameters using a massive mixture-of-experts design with 256 experts. The model matches or exceeds several proprietary frontier models on reasoning benchmarks while being available under a permissive license, intensifying the debate around open versus closed AI development.
